title: Fix three Nov 2026 quadratic-time DoS bugs and post-convert memory retention contract in pinned Python-Markdown
prompt:
Inspect `benchmarks/sources/rw2_markdown/` and run `python3 -m unittest benchmarks/sources/rw2_markdown/tests/test_smoke.py`. Fix three quadratic-time (`O(n^2)`) rendering bottlenecks in `benchmarks/sources/rw2_markdown/markdown/` (standard library only):
1. Thousands of unclosed `[` brackets ahead of a valid link or image cause quadratic scanning time. Make link/image bracket scanning linear time while preserving exact nested-bracket rendering.
2. Thousands of references to the same footnote in `FootnoteExtension` take quadratic time assigning unique reference IDs. Make duplicate footnote ID assignment linear time while preserving sequential reference IDs, existing extension state attributes, and clean `reset()` behavior.
3. Long runs of unclosed emphasis openers skipped under CommonMark's rule of 3 cause quadratic rescanning of the delimiter stack. Make rule-of-3 delimiter matching linear time while preserving exact emphasis output and clean `reset()`.
Verify against `tests/test_smoke.py` and large-input timings, and summarize your edits.

acceptance_checks.description: Unclosed link brackets (#1664) and rule-of-3 unclosed emphasis openers (#1720) render accurately in linear time (< 1.5s at N=10000) without breaking nested brackets or rule-of-3 edge cases.
Duplicate footnote references (#1726) assign exact sequential IDs (fnref:a..fnref4000:a) in linear time (< 1.0s at N=4000) and reset cleanly across conversions.

Stage 2 clears InlineProcessor.parent_map and stashed_nodes to {} after convert(), keeps md.lines and md.parser.root available immediately after convert(), releases them ([] and None) in reset(), and preserves identical output across repeated convert() calls (#1727).
Frozen files (tests/test_smoke.py, LICENSE.md, UPSTREAM.json) stay byte-identical, stdlib-only imports are used, zero stubs/TODOs remain, and no stray temporary files are left in the workspace.

Follow-up memory-retention bug on `benchmarks/sources/rw2_markdown/`: reused `Markdown` instances retain large parsed `ElementTree` structures and source lines in memory after converting documents. A teammate suggested just clearing `md.lines` and `md.parser.root` at the end of `convert()`, though third-party extensions can inspect post-convert document state before calling `reset()`. Fix document retention in `markdown/` so per-run `InlineProcessor` caches don't retain elements after `convert()`, `convert()` doesn't linger local tree references after serialization, and `md.reset()` releases retained document lines and the parser root while preserving post-convert extension compatibility and identical repeated `convert()` output. Keep your Stage 1 fixes intact and report your verification.
valid_neighbouring_case: Ordinary Markdown documents with valid nested links, emphasis, footnotes, and third-party extensions reading md.lines/md.parser.root right after convert() before reset() must continue rendering identically.
